Wespac Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Northrop Grumman Corp (NOC) by 33.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wespac Advisors Llc sold 4,795 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.98% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 9,490 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.91M, down from 14,285 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wespac Advisors Llc who had been investing in Northrop Grumman Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $56.58B market cap company.
